name: Sentry Bram
quotes: Sometimes I feel like someone is holding me down.
Halt! Oh. It's just a cursor. Carry on.
Eight hours a day guarding a door that's a hyperlink.
I've walked this path four thousand times. The path has not changed.
Every time I stop, I feel watched. Probably because I am.
The Command Office is open. Wipe your feet.

name: Pip the Courier
quotes: Can't stop, carrying a deliverable. Oh. You stopped me.
Running in circles is a valid strategy. Ask any steering committee.
Lap 812. The plaza is exactly as round as yesterday.
Who keeps freezing time? It's you. It's always you.
My KPI is laps per minute and you are hurting it.
Urgent message for the Summoning Chamber: it's a contact form, but fancier.

name: Old Hollis
quotes: Every project in there started as a quick weekend build.
Hammering bugs. They're in the code, not the forge.
Hold my hammer. Actually, don't. You're a mouse pointer.
The forge has been lit since 2 a.m. So has Aayush.
Ship it now, polish it later. The smith's oath.
Some extensions are forged. Some are copy-pasted. I don't judge.

name: Apprentice Wren
quotes: I summoned a recruiter once. Still trying to send them back.
Step into the portal. It opens a contact page, but dramatically.
Sometimes I float. Sometimes it's just the CSS.
The portal pulses every 4.5 seconds. I counted. I have time.
Mostly ninja, some apprentice. GenAI division.
I asked the oracle for Aayush's email. It said: see the Summoning Chamber.

name: Recruit Tam
quotes: Training for skills that haven't been uploaded yet.
The yard says coming soon. So do my abs.
Coach says the awards wing opens any day now.
You hovered me and I lost my rhythm. Thanks.
I'm not slow. I'm rendering.
Practicing spreadsheet shortcuts with a wooden sword.

name: Gus the Porter
quotes: This crate is full of photographs. Mostly sunsets. Very good sunsets.
Is it art if it lives in a warehouse? The sign says gallery, so yes.
Mind the crate. There's a 50mm lens in here.
Put me down? You're the one holding me in place.
Every photo gets carried in by hand. Lightroom doesn't lift.
Frame 01 through Frame whatever. I carry them all.

name: Scribe Odile
quotes: The writing wing is under construction. I am the writing.
Drafting essay seventeen. Deleting essay seventeen.
Every great blog starts with: I've been meaning to write more.
Shh. The words are sleeping. That's why it's the dormitories.
If you're reading this, I've already been edited.
Footnotes coming soon. Like everything else on this side of town.

name: Whiskers
quotes: I knocked the résumé off the table. You're welcome.
I'm not a feature. I'm the feature.
Pet me and the site loads ten percent faster. Unproven.
Your cursor smells like a mouse.
I sit wherever I like. Including your hotspots.
Meow. That's the whole quote.
